readme: R300 food-DB-ready entries (exact food-macros-db.json item schema plus source/verify fields, mirroring r100 usda-authored/usda-verified style). Every row transcribed from a fetched USDA FoodData Central record (SR Legacy generic or FDC Branded label data) via the FDC portal search API on 2026-07-25; fdc id in source. USDA SR generic rows use a 100 g serving (qty 100, unit g) so no portion is invented; branded rows use the product label serving exactly. Atwater (4P+4C+9F ~ cal) checked on every row; deviations are USDA specific-factor cases (high-fiber foods: dried chiles, cocoa, spices) and are noted, not errors. DO NOT merge into food-macros-db.json until the publish stage runs its conflict check.
